title: Ordinary mailbox queue: classify the historical idle unpaused root stall
outcome: A queued prompt in an idle, unpaused session either dispatches or carries an explicit, visible reason why it is held.
acceptance: The reason session-11465's queued prompt does not dispatch is identified from source and supported read-only state, and classified as product (scheduler, admission or retained head), provider or environment.

If it is a product defect: a fix with a regression test makes an idle, unpaused session either dispatch its queued head or expose the holding reason in session state; the review pair is clean and the gates pass.
